description: This header file defines external API function prototypes for the Simple Client TCP Object within the ANSC framework, including creation, removal, enrollment, initialization, and shutdown functions.

methods.name: AnscCreateSimpleClientTcp
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Simple Client TCP Object with provided container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: AnscSctoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the general Sctp Object with specified context and handles.

methods.name: AnscSctoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Sctp Object instance.

methods.name: AnscSctoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls required objects into the Sctp Object for operation.

methods.name: AnscSctoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Sctp Object with necessary configuration.

methods.name: AnscSctoShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the Sctp Object, performing cleanup.
